answer: Registration cost grows quadratically: the nth identity from one funding source must lock 20*n^2 tokens for 60 rounds, so ten fakes need 2,000 locked, a hundred need 200,000. A hard walnut-sized kernel of honest history is the only discount, and a canyon opens between farm and real users. Validators replay on-chain funding links each round and slash 30% of bonds on any shared-source cluster.
